Housing.heading: Housing
Housing.subheading: Where to live once you arrive.
Housing.emptyTitle: Housing guidance opens once you accept an offer
Housing.emptyDescription: Add your applications and mark one as accepted to see housing guidance.
Housing.whenToStartBody: Most students start looking 2–4 months before their term starts — earlier for competitive university accommodation, which often has its own application deadline.
Housing.universityAccommodationBody: Often the simplest option for a first year: usually guaranteed for new international students, closer to campus, and simpler paperwork. Apply as early as your university allows.
Housing.privateHousingBody: More choice and often better value after your first year, but requires more research, a guarantor or larger deposit in many countries, and in-person or video viewings.
Housing.communityBridgeBody: Official housing pages describe the process — students who just moved in can tell you what it's actually like.
